title: Treaty of Purandar (1665)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Purandar (1665)", at revision 1381668190, opens: "The Treaty of Purandar was signed on 11 June 1665, between Jai Singh I, commander of the Mughal Empire, and Shivaji, commander of the Maratha Empire. Shivaji was forced to sign the agreement after Jai Singh besieged Purandar fort." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q7837197, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "treaty ending a battle at the fort". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
